Alright, I'll tell you what's going on. According to rumors, that water treatment plant is a home base of some aggressive western spec ops guys. The fact that you returned tells me that either those guys aren't home at the moment, or there's something you're not telling me. Well, in any case, my scouts said they've spotted Scavs at the helipad - looks like they found out about the supplies. The cargo from that heli is very valuable, but there's no point in sending in my people for a gunfight. Return to the helicopter and clean everything up there so that no bastard would slip away with the cargo.}} ==Objectives== *Eliminate any 10 targets around the helicopter area at the water treatment plant on [[Lighthouse]] ==Rewards== *+18,000 [[EXP]] *[[Prapor]] Rep '''+0.02''' *155,000 Roubles **162,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 1 **178,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 2 * Unlocks purchase of [[AK 7.62x39 Molot Arms 75-round drum magazine]] at [[Prapor]] LL3 * Unlocks Dirty [[Hideout]] ceiling style {{quote|Good work, warrior. Now, all we have to do is deal with those tourists. Here, soldier, grab your share.}} ==Guide== For this quest you have to kill 10 [[Rogues]], [[Scavs]], or PMC's in a specific area of the water treatment plant on [[Lighthouse]]. Any kills outside of the marked area '''do not''' count towards the objective.
